name: Virtual Smoke
definition: A technique for visualizing three-dimensional vector and scalar fields (e.g., velocity and temperature) by simulating the injection of colored smoke from a user-selected seed point into a fixed vector field, where the smoke color is mapped to the local scalar value.
summary: Virtual Smoke is an interactive 3D flow visualization technique that simulates colored smoke injection into a fixed vector field, using an event queue ordered by propagation time to simultaneously display flow direction and scalar properties.
